title: Install multimedia codecs
description: Play MP3, AAC, FLAC, H.264 and more. Installs the audio and video codec packages from the official repositories, and can remove them again.
author: Tux Store

vars.pkgs: a52dec faac faad2 flac jasper lame libdca libdv libmad libmpeg2 libtheora libvorbis libxv wavpack x264 xvidcore

download_mb.label: Download size (basic set)
download_mb.shell: pacman -Si a52dec faac faad2 flac jasper lame libdca libdv libmad libmpeg2 libtheora libvorbis libxv wavpack x264 xvidcore 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Download Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

installed_mb.label: Installed size (basic set)
installed_mb.shell: pacman -Si a52dec faac faad2 flac jasper lame libdca libdv libmad libmpeg2 libtheora libvorbis libxv wavpack x264 xvidcore 2>/dev/null | awk '/^Installed Size/ {v=$4; u=$5; if (u=="KiB") v/=1024; else if (u=="GiB") v*=1024; else if (u=="B") v/=1048576; t+=v} END {printf "%d\n", t+0.5}'

info.note: Sizes are for the basic set, read from your package database. Packages you already have are skipped, so the real download is usually smaller. The full set adds ffmpeg and the GStreamer plugins.

welcome.title: Install multimedia codecs
message: Codecs let your system play and create common audio and video formats: MP3, AAC, FLAC, Vorbis, Theora, H.264 and more.
Without them some videos and songs may not play, or play without sound.
This add-on installs them from the official Arch repositories with pacman. Nothing is built or downloaded from anywhere else.

choose.title: What do you want to install?
choose.message: You can run this again later to add the other set.

options.label: Basic codecs
hint: The classic set: a52dec, faac, faad2, flac, jasper, lame, libdca, libdv, libmad, libmpeg2, libtheora, libvorbis, libxv, wavpack, x264, xvidcore.

set.pkgs: a52dec faac faad2 flac jasper lame libdca libdv libmad libmpeg2 libtheora libvorbis libxv wavpack x264 xvidcore

options.label: Full (basic + ffmpeg and GStreamer plugins)
hint: Everything in Basic, plus ffmpeg and the GStreamer plugins (base, good, bad, ugly, libav) that many video players and browsers use.

set.pkgs: a52dec faac faad2 flac jasper lame libdca libdv libmad libmpeg2 libtheora libvorbis libxv wavpack x264 xvidcore ffmpeg gst-libav gst-plugins-base gst-plugins-good gst-plugins-bad gst-plugins-ugly

command.label: Checking your system…
shell: [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] || { echo "Tux Store is running as root. Start it as a normal user; it asks for the password only when needed."; exit 0; }
for t in pkexec pacman; do
command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

command.label: Looking at what is already installed…
shell: pacman -Si "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue      # not in your repositories: handled below

command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The required tool '$t' is missing."; exit 0; }
[ ! -e /var/lib/pacman/db.lck ] || { echo "pacman is locked (/var/lib/pacman/db.lck exists). Another package manager may be running. Wait for it to finish, then try again."; exit 0; }

un_run.title: Removing codecs…
un_run.message: Please don't turn off the computer until I'm finished.

commands.label: Removing the codec packages
shell: # Two passes: a package may only become removable after another one is gone.
if pacman -Rns --noconfirm "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "removed $p"; elif [ "$pass" = 2 ]; then echo "kept $p (other software needs it)"; fi
